query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) AS "total!"
        FROM expenses e
        WHERE e.expense_date >= (date_trunc($1, now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')
                                  - ('1 ' || $1)::interval)::date
          AND e.expense_date <  date_trunc($1, now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::date
